value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task's "if you pick up the key, you must also open the door" has a condition with no timing cue, and "also" makes it RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open). texts: If the agent picks up the key (has_door_key ever holds), the agent must also open the door at some point, before or after the pickup.
